While browsing for venues we came over the company by the name "BookEventz". After we contacted them, It was all hassale free they also helped us finalize the venue and all the elements. They helped us organize the event in such a smooth fashion that now at the end of the event i am very satisfied with their services and the event was very well organized so kudos to Team BookEventz and In the future i recommend if you have any events coming up do contact them their team is very hospitable and friendly, Therefore much recommended.

Feedback : You guys are doing really great also you guys have a very beautiful design sense and a good flow of action.


TransIndia Group

Hundred people on such short notice and it was nicely done. I think this will go a long way and most of our events will be going to BookEventz now.

It was really good, and I really give a cheets to Sajid and Abhishek for giving me the best coordination and support regarding to every perspective. Yes, Looking forward for more, events to be coming up with them, globally, I would say. So yes. So cheers for BookEventz.

The overall experience is very good. If you ask me for the rating, I will be five or five rating for the experience. Everything is well good. The Kohinoor Elite is every good suggestion. It is matched my expectations, like what I was expecting. Food quality is very good and taste is also very good. So I'll definitely put that to you for the, future events.

The food was also delicious. Thank you Bookeventz Team

Shreya & Ricky
